fusions.name: Tripline
fusions.desc: Casts a strand that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 50% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Spat Webbing
fusions.desc: Spits a wide cone of webbing, dealing 10 damage to everything caught in it and making each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Strung Line
fusions.desc: Strings a barrier 7 tiles long that holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Silk Ledger
fusions.desc: Every time you hit an enemy, a mark builds on it, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a mark fades every 4 seconds.
